answer: A name gets on the books only through Endorsed engraver guild licence, because a licence engravers renew after plate audits. Each name is charged a 10-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. ivory stays on the record. One timber, one entry. The jetty is checked, not assumed.
